description.value: Caribbean Market is the leading retailer of Caribbean, African, and Newfoundland specialty foods in Western Canada, operating from New Westminster for over 20 years. Their shelves carry authentic groceries from across the Caribbean (with a strong Jamaican focus), as well as African and Newfoundland products — from ackee and breadfruit to spices, fresh produce, frozen foods, and baked goods. Touring cyclists passing through New Westminster will find an unusually broad range of cultural staples and everyday groceries that are hard to source elsewhere in the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at caribbeanmarket.ca confirms an active brick-and-mortar grocery store at 804 12th Street, New Westminster BC V3M 4K1 with phone 6045229480, selling Caribbean, African, and Newfoundland specialty foods across categories including fresh produce, frozen foods, dairy, snacks, and pantry staples. The About Us page states over 20 years in operation, confirming it is an established business. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the website's physical address is New Westminster BC V3M 4K1 — these are distinct municipalities; OSM coordinates should be verified against the street address.
OSM record has no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website contact-information page.
URL discovery confidence flagged as 'medium' by the discovery process; however, website content confirms name, business type, and location match the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established brick-and-mortar grocery store with over 20 years of operation offering a broad range of fresh, frozen, and pantry groceries; a legitimate and useful resupply stop for touring cyclists in the New Westminster area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Also operates an online store shipping across Canada and the USA (Shopify). The in-store and online operations share the same brand and website.
